verse.verse_1: WHEN WHAT IS to happen comes to pass --
verse.verse_2: Which is bound to happen undoubtedly --
verse.verse_4: When the earth is shaken up convulsively,
verse.verse_6: Turned to dust, floating in the air,
verse.verse_8: Those of the right hand -- how (happy) will be those of the right hand!
verse.verse_9: Then those of the left hand -- how (unhappy) will be those of the left hand!
verse.verse_13: A number of the earlier peoples,
verse.verse_14: And a few of later ages,
verse.verse_17: Youths of never-ending bloom will pass round to them
verse.verse_18: Cups and decanters, beakers full of sparkling wine,
verse.verse_20: And such fruits as they fancy,
verse.verse_22: And companions with big beautiful eyes
verse.verse_24: As recompense for all they had done.
verse.verse_25: They will hear no nonsense there or talk of sin,
verse.verse_27: As for those of the right hand -- how (happy) those of the right hand --
verse.verse_28: They will be in (the shade) of thornless lote
verse.verse_29: And acacia covered with heaps of bloom,
verse.verse_35: We have formed them in a distinctive fashion,
verse.verse_38: For those of the right hand.
verse.verse_40: And a crowd of the later.
verse.verse_41: But those of the left hand -- how (unhappy) those of the left hand --
verse.verse_42: Will be in the scorching wind and boiling water,
verse.verse_43: Under the shadow of thick black smoke
verse.verse_45: They were endowed with good things
verse.verse_46: But persisted in that greater sin,
verse.verse_47: And said: "What! When we are dead and turned to dust and bones, shall we then be raised again?
verse.verse_49: Say: "Indeed, the earlier and the later generations
verse.verse_50: Will be gathered together on a certain day which is predetermined.
verse.verse_51: Then you, the erring and the deniers,
verse.verse_52: Will eat of the tree of Zaqqum,
verse.verse_54: And drink over it scalding water,
verse.verse_55: Lapping it up like female camels raging of thirst with disease."
verse.verse_56: Such will be their welcome on the Day of Judgement.
verse.verse_57: It is He who created you, then why do you not affirm the truth?
verse.verse_58: Just consider (the semen) that you emit,
verse.verse_59: Do you create it, or We are its creator?
verse.verse_60: We have incorporated death in your constitution, and We shall not be hindered
verse.verse_61: From replacing you with others or raising you in a way you do not know.
verse.verse_62: You have known the first creation, then why do you not reflect?
verse.verse_63: Just ponder over what you sow:
verse.verse_64: Do you give it its increase, or are We the giver?
verse.verse_65: We could turn it, if We pleased, into straw; then you would rue the day,
verse.verse_67: Indeed, we have been deprived of the fruits of our labour."
verse.verse_68: Consider the water that you drink.
verse.verse_69: Do you send it down from the clouds, or We send it down?
verse.verse_70: We could make it brackish, if We pleased; so why do you not acknowledge thanks?
verse.verse_71: Consider the fire that you strike (and get by friction).
verse.verse_72: Have you raised its tree, or We have raised it?
verse.verse_73: We have made it as a reminder and convenience for the needy.
verse.verse_74: So glorify your Lord, the most supreme.
verse.verse_75: So I call the placement of the stars to witness --
verse.verse_76: And this surely is great evidence if you can understand --
verse.verse_77: That this is indeed the glorious Qur'an
verse.verse_79: Only they can reach it who are clean (of mind).
verse.verse_80: It has been revealed by the Lord of all the worlds.
verse.verse_81: Then why do you dissimulate this Revelation?
verse.verse_82: You live by calling it a lie.
verse.verse_83: Then how is it that when the (dying) breath is withdrawn into the throat (and rattles),
verse.verse_84: And you wait for the moment (of death),
verse.verse_85: We are closer to him than you, even though you cannot see?
verse.verse_86: Then why, if you are not indebted (to Us for life),
verse.verse_87: Can you not bring him back? (Answer) if you are truthful
verse.verse_88: Then, if he is one of the honoured,
verse.verse_89: There will be peace and plenty, and gardens of tranquility for him.
verse.verse_90: If he is of those of the right hand,
verse.verse_91: There will be the salutation by those of the right hand: "Peace on you.
verse.verse_92: But if he is of the deniers and the errants,
verse.verse_93: The welcome will be boiling water
verse.verse_95: This is indeed the ultimate truth.
verse.verse_96: Then praise your Lord, the most supreme.
